title: uses-recover
summary: Recovers the uses edges of units that ship without source, from the vendor's .hpp headers and a dcc map; never reads a .dcu; --apply stores them in the index
intro: Read this when a project uses a library shipped as compiled units only and you want to know what those units depend on. uses-recover lists every unit the index uses but has no source for, reads its interface uses from the C++Builder header the vendor ships, follows the units those headers name and, given a dcc map, says which the linker pulled in. --project resolves unit aliases first; --apply stores the result so cycles, impact and the uses graph see past the library. No .dcu is read.

help: uses edges of units with NO source in --db or any --library-db, from the vendor's C++Builder
.hpp headers (#include lines = interface uses; System/SysInit dropped; never reads a .dcu).
--hpp-dir is repeatable, not recursive, first hit wins; sourceless targets are followed.
--map: a dcc -GS/-GD map; in_map per unit, map_only = linked units no header reaches.
--project: the .dproj's DCC_UnitAlias + the Delphi targets' defaults (WinProcs=Winapi.Windows ...);
a used alias is classified by its target.
--apply WRITES --db: one files row per recovered header (language hpp), its includes as interface
unit_uses rows, then the uses pass binds the project's rows to them; idempotent. Without it: read-only.
json: units[{unit, reach direct|header, used_by, header, in_map, uses[{unit, status
indexed|library|sourceless}]}], no_header[], map_only[], aliases[{unit, to, status}], headers_found,
Exit 0 = reported (zero included); 2 = no --db/--hpp-dir, missing DB/dir/map/project, or --apply on

questions.ask: What do the compiled-only library units this project uses depend on?
Which sourceless units does the linker actually pull in, and which does no header explain?
How do I make cycles, impact and the uses graph see through a compiled-only library?
